title: Inventory manager counts 25 Office Chairs and applies the row's count: stock is corrected through an adjustment move
_seedNote: demo seed: stock levels for Desk Combination (row 1, sorted by product) and Office Chair (row 2) at WH/Stock. Also tops the chairs up so J-SALES-01 yields a Ready delivery on a re-run.

steps.name: Open Inventory > Stock: both stock levels are listed
Count 25 Office Chairs and press the row's Apply

actions.label: Apply (Office Chair row) — straight after typing, as a user would

oql.label: an adjustment move for the chairs is done
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(m.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.StockMove AS m WHERE m.IsInventoryAdjustment = true AND m.Status = 'Done' AND m/Inventory.StockMove_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269'

outcome.label: 25 Office Chairs on hand at WH/Stock, the count cleared
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(l.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.StockLevel AS l WHERE l/Inventory.StockLevel_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269' AND l.Quantity = 25 AND l.CountedQuantity = NULL
